findings.title: Recurring cancel calendar deletes never awaited
findings.body: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-cancel path does bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(credential); for (...) { const deletedEvent = await calendar?.deleteEvent(...); apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); } }). forEach does not wait for async callbacks, so the outer handler continues to Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes)) while apiDeletes is still empty. The pushed deleteEvent promises are added after the Promise.all has already been constructed, so recurring booking cancellations leak events on external calendars and apiDeletes never reflects failures.

findings.title: Async forEach fire-and-forget calendar/video deletes
findings.body: In packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...) ... return deleteMeeting(...) }) is not awaited and its returned promises are discarded. The surrounding try/catch cannot catch async rejections from forEach callbacks, and the function returns true and sends reschedule email without waiting for calendar.deleteEvent or video deleteMeeting to finish. Failed deletions are silently lost and previous time is not freed.

findings.title: Async forEach fire-and-forget calendar/video deletes
findings.body: In packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...) ... }) is not awaited and its promises are discarded. The surrounding try/catch cannot observe async errors, and the function proceeds to send reschedule email and return true before deletions complete. Calendar and video cancellations can be skipped or fail silently.

findings.title: Async forEach fire-and-forget reschedule deletes
findings.body: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings.tsx requestReschedule does bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...) ... return deleteMeeting(...) }) without awaiting the callbacks or collecting promises. Deletion of the old calendar/video events runs detached from the mutation, errors are unhandled, and the reschedule email and webhook are sent regardless of whether the old slot was freed.

findings.title: getCalendarCredentials now returns promises as calendar
findings.body: In packages/core/CalendarManager.ts getCalendarCredentials still runs synchronously but now stores const calendar = getCalendar(credential) where getCalendar returns Promise<Calendar|null>. Its return value changed from {integration, credential, calendar: Calendar|null} to {integration, credential, calendar: Promise<Calendar|null>} without changing the function signature to async. Only getConnectedCalendars was updated to await item.calendar; any other caller expecting a sync Calendar instance will receive a Promise object, treat it as truthy, and call calendar methods on a Promise at runtime.
